title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Monday, 26 October 2026
description: SK Hyper seeks $350 billion for its first-phase South Korean AI data centre buildout, federal redundancies surge past $100 million across three departments, Queensland small businesses react angrily to proposed discretionary trust tax changes, and Gold Coast police return seized jet skis for lack of legal disposal power. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
